review_scope: Evidence-based assistant audit against the frozen report text; not a human gold standard and not PoC execution validation

rating_scale.pass: The core meaning is supported by the report and preserved in the formal candidate
rating_scale.partial: The direction is useful but a condition is missing, unnecessary, over-scoped, or under-scoped
rating_scale.fail: The formula does not express the report's core claim or direct violation

element_review.interpretation: All eight valid element files preserve a report-supported core P, I and V at the natural-language level. This is a provisional evidence audit, not a measured population accuracy.

formal_candidate_reviews.reason: P preserves approval and unattached/unvoted conditions, but the effect reuses owner_has_approval instead of representing transfer success or failure. The model itself declared the placeholder blocking, so the pipeline correctly stopped.

The report-supported stale-execution violation is preserved. Formal P omits the extracted intent-change and slippage-satisfied qualifiers and makes the example-specific gas-price drop necessary; the inferred deadline is useful but not concretely defined by the report.

The prerequisites capture the broken TWAP and amountOutMin=0, but the formula forbids buyback_completes rather than requiring rejection of a manipulated price or preventing unfair output. This passed structural checks and is the clearest false continuation in the set.

The swapped event positions are represented, but the formula uses token!=recipient and off-chain reliance as necessary conditions. The invariant should directly equate each emitted position with the corresponding on-chain token and recipient, independent of whether an indexer consumes it.

The liability-positive/count-zero violation is preserved. Requiring count==1 matches the report's one-user scenario, but it is not a general invariant when more than one requester may exist; membership or count>0 would generalize more safely.

The invariant and direct head-loss violation have the correct polarity. One selected precondition is mapped to the wrong duplicate symbol and actual bug state is mixed into P, so the antecedent is not a clean representation of the execution prerequisites.

Nested multicall, shared flag, self-delegatecall, and the subsequent payment-check revert are preserved with the correct safety direction. Remaining warnings concern unspecified actor and exact operation/value details, not the core claim.

rejected_or_incomplete.reason: The report has three direct effects for mint, burn and swap, while the current element schema accepts at most two direct impacts. The retry remained faithful but was rejected; this is not evidence that the report is unsuitable.
Element extraction preserved 2^106 and 2^127 facts, but both formal attempts weakened explicit bounds to >0 or >=0 (and one invented divisibility by 106). Numeric fidelity correctly rejected them.
The readiness response was malformed JSON, so no P/I/V was generated. This is an engineering completion failure, not a semantic judgment on the report.

metric_warning: The 1/7 all-pass figure is a provisional audit of generated formal candidates, not a defensible accuracy estimate. The set is small and there is no independent human gold annotation. Z3 satisfiability is not counted as semantic correctness.
